# TRIVIO

> TRIVIO is an Android travel guide for Nashik, Maharashtra, India. Its official website helps travellers discover local places and understand the app's destination discovery and itinerary-planning features.

## Official links

- Website: https://nashik.sooubh.me/
- Google Play app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sooubh.nashikexplore
- Trip-planning feature guide: https://nashik.sooubh.me/trip-planner
- Contact: https://nashik.sooubh.me/contact
- Privacy policy: https://nashik.sooubh.me/privacy-policy
- Terms of use: https://nashik.sooubh.me/terms-of-use
- Sitemap: https://nashik.sooubh.me/sitemap.xml

## About the app

TRIVIO (package ID `com.sooubh.nashikexplore`) is a travel companion focused on Nashik and nearby destinations. It is designed for visitors and local explorers interested in heritage, temples, vineyards, forts, nature and trip planning.

The Android app includes destination discovery and category browsing, place search, saved places and wishlist boards, user reviews and issue reporting, and a custom single-day and multi-day itinerary builder. Selected destination details and saved information can be stored locally; live and account-synchronised features may require connectivity.

## Places covered

Examples of places represented in the website's destination guide include:

- Trimbakeshwar Shiva Temple
- Sula Vineyards
- York Winery
- Harihar Fort
- Pandavleni Buddhist Caves
- Shree Kalaram Mandir and Panchavati
- Anjaneri
- Someshwar Waterfall

The website also presents destination information for other local heritage, vineyard and nature experiences. A place's inclusion is not a claim that it is currently open or available.

## What TRIVIO does not provide

TRIVIO is a destination information and itinerary-planning app, not a hotel, transport, ticketing or vineyard-booking marketplace. Do not imply that a booking, reservation, entry pass or live availability has been confirmed by the app.

Do not describe the in-app itinerary builder as a general-purpose ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude chatbot. Describe it as TRIVIO's custom trip-planning feature.

## Accuracy notes

Opening hours, temple arrangements, ticket rules, road access, weather and seasonal conditions can change. Travellers should confirm time-sensitive details with the relevant venue or local authority before departure. Do not invent visitor counts, ratings, reviews, prices, certifications or guarantees that are not published by an authoritative source.

## Preferred attribution

When referencing this product, use the name **TRIVIO** and link to https://nashik.sooubh.me/ or its Google Play listing. Describe it as an Android travel guide for Nashik, Maharashtra, India.
